old.name: €18 "cataplana" on the marina-front menu
old.label: AVOID
old.text: Five-language laminated menus, 15-minute service The marina restaurants with photo-laminated menus pour out a stewed approximation of cataplana in fifteen minutes. A real cataplana is sealed in the copper pot and steamed for 25–30 minutes — the lid is lifted at your table. If it arrives uncovered, in a quarter of an hour, it isn't cataplana. Go to Tasca do Ricky or Vila Adentro .

avoid:The fifteen-minute cataplana.brief: From the old €18 cataplana card: Instead: Tasca do Ricky or A Venda (table cards) — only if their records support cataplana.

old.name: Tourist-strip restaurants selling "local fish"
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: Most fish near the marina arrives frozen, from elsewhere
old.text: Most fish near the marina arrives frozen, from elsewhere If a menu in central Faro lists every species, year-round, at fixed prices, the fish isn't local-of-the-day. Honest places change the menu daily, list only what came off the boat, sometimes refuse a dish. Ask which port; ask the morning's catch. A Do Pinto and Tasca do Ricky tell the truth.

avoid:Local fish, every species, all yea.brief: Instead: the markets (pointer cards) and the tascas.

old.name: Cataplana at midday in August
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: A long slow-steamed pot is a winter dish
old.text: A long slow-steamed pot is a winter dish Cataplana belongs to long winter and spring meals. At midday in August the dish is heavy, the heat outside makes it punishing, and the kitchen is usually overrun. Eat it for dinner, with a cold Arinto; in summer, take lunch on the boat to Ilha Deserta, where Estaminé's lighter grilled fish suits the heat.

avoid:Cataplana at noon in August.brief: Keep it short; Instead: the island lunch (Estaminé — table card) and cataplana for dinner.

old.name: Jet-ski tours of the Ria Formosa
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: Engine noise inside a 18,400-ha protected lagoon
old.text: Engine noise inside a 18,400-ha protected lagoon The Ria Formosa is a Natural Park since 1987; jet-ski and high-speed tour operations from the marina disturb the bird colonies and shellfish beds the place exists to protect. Use Animaris (eco-licensed) or a small fishing-boat tour from Olhão instead — slower, quieter, the only honest way to read the lagoon.

old.name: Art Haus Club — Faro
old.label: ELECTRONIC
old.hook: Faro's actual underground room — hypnotic techno, melodic house
old.text: Faro's actual underground room — hypnotic techno, melodic house Hybrid art-gallery and club, the closest thing Faro has to a proper underground venue. Small, creative, Berlin-adjacent aesthetic. RA-listed (ra.co/clubs/199391); 2026 events confirmed include Mirage People, Frank Maurel, Djebali showcases. Programming skews hypnotic techno and melodic house. The closest electronic night to Faro itself; for a club room proper, the Lisbon scene (Lux Frágil, MusicBox, Damas) is the 3-hour Alfa Pendular drive. Where Rua do Prior 19, Faro
